ruleset.name: FetchStreamResourceRuleset
ruleset.description: Detects jOOQ fetchStream() calls that are not wrapped in try-with-resources. Such calls can leak database connections if an exception occurs during stream processing.

rule.name: FetchStreamMustBeInTryWithResources
rule.message: fetchStream() must be wrapped in try-with-resources to prevent connection leaks on exception
rule.description: jOOQ's fetchStream() returns a lazy JDBC-backed stream that holds a borrowed connection until closed. If processing throws, the stream must be closed via try-with-resources to return the connection to the pool.
